title.narrative: Comprehensive Care Program for Habitat and Housing Vulnerability with a Focus on Children and Adolescents
Programa de Atencin Integral a la Vulnerabilidad del Hbitat y de la Vivienda con Foco en Nios, Nias y Adolescentes

description.narrative: Contribuir al desarrollo integral de los hogares de reas Precarias (AP) de Uruguay. Los objetivos especficos son: (i) reducir las privaciones de infraestructura y servicios bsicos en las AP con alta presencia de NNA y poblacin migrante; (ii) aumentar el acceso a soluciones de vivienda adecuadas en las AP con presencia de NNA y poblacin migrante; (iii) expandir el acceso a servicios de cuidado y educacin en las AP con foco en NNA y poblacin migrante; y (iv) fortalecer las capacidades institucionales y los mecanismos de coordinacin para intervenir en las AP.

To contribute to the comprehensive development of households in precarious areas (PA) in Uruguay. The specific objectives are: (i) to reduce deprivations in infrastructure and basic services in AP with a high presence of children and adolescents (NNA) and migrant populations; (ii) to increase access to adequate housing solutions in AP with the presence of NNA and migrant populations; (iii) to expand access to care and education services in AP with a focus on NNA and migrant populations; and (iv) to strengthen institutional capacities and coordination mechanisms for interventions in AP.
